 from ansible.plugins.loader import connection_loader, become_loader
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stderr, expected', [
+    (b'plain stderr\r\n', b'plain stderr\r\n'),
+    (b'before\r\n#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">bad</S>',
+     b'before\r\n#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">bad</S>'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">bad</Objs>',
+     b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">bad</Objs>'),
+])
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml_unchanged(stderr, expected):
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(stderr) == expected
+
+
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml_embedded_and_multiline():
+    block = (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1">\r\n'
+             b'<S S="Error">first_x000D__x000A_second</S>\r\n</Objs>')
+    stderr = b'prefix\r\n' + block + b'tail\r\n' + block + b' end'
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(stderr) == b'prefix\r\nfirst\r\nsecondtail\r\nfirst\r\nsecond end'
+
+
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml_without_object_attributes():
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs><S S="Error">bad</S></Objs>after') == b'badafter'
+
+
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml_cp437_and_later_valid_block():
+    malformed = b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">broken'
+    valid = b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">caf\x82</S></Objs>'
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(malformed + b'\r\n' + valid + b'!') == malformed + b'\r\ncaf\xc3\xa9!'
+
+
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml_crlf_header_and_multiple_objects():
+    stderr = (b'before\r\nCLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">one</S></Objs>'
+              b'<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">two</S></Objs>after')
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(stderr) == b'beforeone\r\ntwoafter'
+
+
+def test_exec_command_replaces_windows_stderr_clixml():
+    conn = ssh.Connection(PlayContext(), StringIO())
+    conn._shell = MagicMock(_IS_WINDOWS=True)
+    conn.get_option = MagicMock(return_value='host')
+    conn._build_command = MagicMock(return_value='ssh host command')
+    conn._run = MagicMock(return_value=(1, b'', b'prefix #< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">error</S></Objs> suffix'))
+
+    assert conn.exec_command('command') == (1, b'', b'prefix error suffix')
+
+
